# Copilot instructions — jaecoo-landing-page

Purpose: Provide repository-specific guidance for Copilot sessions (build/test/lint commands, architecture overview, and repository conventions).

---

## Build, test, and lint commands

- Existing npm scripts (package.json):
  - `npm run minify` — runs `minify.js` (in-place minification of listed JS and CSS files). Run from the repository root.
  - Equivalent: `node minify.js`

- Tailwind (not scripted in package.json):
  - Recommended command to generate the Tailwind output used by the minifier:
    - `npx tailwindcss -i tailwind-input.css -o tailwind-purged.css --content './*.html' --minify`
    - Run from repo root. Adjust `--content` or `tailwind.config.js` if HTML files live in subfolders.

- Tests / Lint:
  - No test or lint scripts are configured in package.json.

---

## High-level architecture (big picture)

- Type: Static, multi-page landing site. Most pages are standalone HTML files in the repository root (e.g., `index.html`, `about.html`, `j5ev.html`, ...). A small subsite lives under `casing-store/`.

- Per-page asset model: Each page typically has a matching CSS and JS file:
  - CSS: `styles-<slug>.css`
  - JS:   `scripts-<slug>.js`
  Pages include those files directly.

- Tailwind pipeline:
  - `tailwind-input.css` contains the Tailwind directives (`@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;`).
  - `tailwind.config.js` currently targets `content: ['./*.html']`.
  - The expected output file is `tailwind-purged.css` which is included in the `minify.js` CSS list.

- Minification pipeline:
  - `minify.js` runs Terser (JS) and CleanCSS (CSS) and writes results back to the original files (in-place).
  - `minify.js` contains explicit arrays `jsFiles` and `cssFiles` listing which files are processed — these lists must be kept in sync with repository pages.

- Runtime configuration:
  - `config.js` exposes `CONFIG`, `getConfig(key)`, and `initializeConfigFromDOM()`.
  - Runtime values may be set via `window.JAECOO_CONFIG` or via `data-*` attributes on the `<html>` element (dataset keys: whatsapp, phone, email, analytics, etc.).

- Deployment model: Static files are served as-is. The repository does not include a server build step here.

---

## Key conventions and repository-specific rules

- File naming convention:
  - `scripts-<page>.js` and `styles-<page>.css` map to `<page>.html` (root-level). Follow this naming when adding pages.

- Minifier is explicit and in-place:
  - When adding pages, add the corresponding filenames to `minify.js` arrays; otherwise files will not be minified by the existing script.
  - `minify.js` overwrites files; commit or stash changes before running it (or run it on copies) if you need to preserve source formatting.

- Tailwind scope:
  - `tailwind.config.js` only scans `./*.html` by default. If HTML files are added under subfolders, update `content` accordingly so unused utilities are purged/kept correctly.

- Configuration injection:
  - For runtime overrides, prefer setting `window.JAECOO_CONFIG` in an inline script or use `<html data-whatsapp="..." data-email="...">` to avoid changing `config.js`.

- Subsite:
  - `casing-store/` is treated as a self-contained static sub-app (it contains its own `index.html` and `script.js`).

---

## Files and locations to inspect (quick map)

- `package.json` — scripts & dependencies
- `minify.js` — minification lists & logic (primary build script)
- `tailwind-input.css` & `tailwind-purged.css` — Tailwind input/output
- `tailwind.config.js` — Tailwind content globs
- `config.js` — runtime configuration helper
- `*.html`, `styles-*.css`, `scripts-*.js` (root) — application pages and page-scoped assets

---

If a Copilot session is asked to add pages or update assets, follow these explicit steps:
1. Create `<name>.html` at repo root (or `casing-store/` when adding to that subsite).
2. Add `styles-<name>.css` and `scripts-<name>.js` alongside other page assets.
3. Update `minify.js` arrays (`jsFiles` and `cssFiles`) to include the new files.
4. Rebuild Tailwind (if needed) to regenerate `tailwind-purged.css`.
5. Run `npm run minify` (or `node minify.js`) to produce minified artifacts.
